topic: Legacy ITE / Gould-ITE lighting panelboard renewal parts (pre-Siemens S1/S2)
detail: No OEM ITE, ITE Imperial or Gould-ITE panelboard renewal-parts catalogue was found online. Type designations in the scope (ITE NQB/NLAB/NHB, EQ panelboards, 'CDP' early series) were NOT confirmed in any document reached. Need scanned ITE 'Distribution Products' catalogues (1960s-1980s) or Siemens-Allis price lists; try archive.org, worldradiohistory, eBay catalogue scans, and Siemens legacy support (1-800-333-7421).

topic: SpeedFax Section 12 (Switchboards) page 12-32 branch device mounting kits
detail: SpeedFax Sec.11 p.11-15 says: 'For Series 5, Series 6, CDP6 and VB6 panels as well as FC20, FCI, FCII, SB1, SB2 and SB3 distribution switchboards, see page 12-32 for branch device mounting kits.' US Section 12 PDF not retrieved; try media.distributordatasolutions.com siemenscomplete documents or usa.siemens.com/speedfax.

topic: Installation instructions for P1/P2/P3/P4/P5 strap kits
detail: SpeedFax references Installation Instructions for S3VA41T(D) accommodating xGB/xGB2, and drawing refs (11-D-2267-01 BBKB32, 11-D-2894-01 BBKVA5262P2S, 11-A-2010-01 P1SCRWS, etc.). Siemens SIOS (support.industry.siemens.com) likely hosts these as PDFs; search by kit number. Needed for torque, fastener and dimension data (currently unknown for nearly all parts).

topic: Original P1 / S1 / S2 branch connector replacement parts
detail: 2021 SpeedFax lists only Revised P1 branch connectors (P1CONACPHCU, P1CONBPHAL, P1CONBPHCU). Whether these fit original P1 or S1/S2 interiors is not stated (table column marks Revised P1 only). Older SpeedFax editions (2010-2014) should be checked for original P1 connector kits.

topic: Revised P1 main breaker kits with breaker (MBK...A with amp rating)
detail: SpeedFax p.11-14 lists ~47 factory kits with breaker included (MBKED3100A, MBKQR1125A..MBKQR3225HA, MBKVAM3150A..MBKVAH3400A, MBKFD3150A..MBKFD3250A, MBKJD1300A..MBKJD32400A). These are referenced in 'replacement' notes on strap-kit records but not catalogued individually in this batch. Canadian equivalents (MBKQR12225A, MBKFD33250A, MBKJD33400A, MBKHF33250A, MBKED33100A) in SI-LP-1633.

topic: SMM/SMD metering switchboard connecting kits and meter socket kits
detail: 2005 price list p.8-13: SMMBQMK, SMMQJMK, SMMEDMK, SMMFDMK, SMMCEMK, SMMTFMK (connecting kits for SMM and SMD metering switchboards) and MSK2001/MSK2003 replacement meter socket kits. Not catalogued in this batch.

topic: Fusible branch connecting strap kits (F602, F657, F671, F672, F6150D, F6162D, VB657, VB671, VB610, VB6150) and Vacu-Break/VK switch kits
detail: Listed on SpeedFax pp.11-96, 11-110 and s3/s2; outside breaker-mounting focus; not catalogued.

topic: Integral bus-mounted SPD kits for P1 (TPS3/TPS4) and P2/P3 (TPS4 01 / TPS4 L1)
detail: P1 has space for one TPS3 or TPS4 SPD kit (p.11-9). SPD catalog numbers are in SpeedFax Section 10 (TPS), not retrieved.

topic: Number strips, directory cards, locks, keys
detail: NBK01A-03A (P1), NBK3-8 (P2/P3), LPDC01/02, MCHK, LPJSPDNUT01, LPTS01, LP3RHP01, LPKEY01A/B (key B363A), LPLOCK01A/02A/03A (FAS-Latch, 11-1895-61/62/63), XTP060 touch-up paint - listed on pp.11-20, 11-21, 11-54; not catalogued as parts.

topic: Current ABB BuyLog Section 11 (2021/2022) - ReliaGear neXT kit numbers and Spectra retrofit kits
detail: Contains ReliaGear neXT catalog nomenclature, single breaker-installation-kit catalog number, 'Retrofit kit for Spectra panelboards' and 'Spectra (obsoleted) bolt-on mounting hardware'. Host electrification.us.abb.com returns 503/empty reply from this container; try another network or distributor mirror.

topic: Spectra bolt-on strap instruction leaflets DEH-047, DEH-059, DEH-060, DEH-061, DEH-062 and DEH042 cover supports
detail: Would give strap part numbers, kit contents and torques for AMCB EB/SE, SF, SG, SK/KM and EY kits, plus cover-support catalog numbers by panel width. Copies exist on manualmachine.com (HTTP 403 here) - e.g. DEH061 AMCB3KM/AMCB2KM, DEH042 SE/SF/TE/TF/TQ/TEL cover supports, AMCB4GB/AMCB6GB, AMCB2GM/AMCB3GM.

topic: Spectra plug-in module instructions GEH-5623/5624/5625/5626/5643/5673/5675/5677 and hardware kits GEH-5913
detail: Module-level torques and bus-clip part numbers; GEH-5913 should confirm AHK/AHKB kit contents and the module-to-AHK mapping (PDF text column alignment on BuyLog p.11-44 is ambiguous).

topic: GEH5589 APN/APNB interiors installation
detail: Install of Spectra interiors into APB boxes; listed on manualmachine (blocked).

topic: Main lug kit instructions GEH-5588 / GEH-5630 and AMB-numbered main lug kits (p.11-28)
detail: BuyLog p.11-28 lists a second main-lug numbering (AMB3600MAF, AMB3120MAF, AMB3120DMAF, AMB3250CAF, AMB3600CAF, AMB3800CAF, AMB3120CAF, AMB3120NF, cover plates AFPML4X/6X/6XW) apparently for factory-installed/merchandise panels; relationship to AML modules (p.11-45) unresolved. Not yet catalogued as parts.

topic: Spectra ANK neutral kit full table (p.11-27) and ADS switch load bases 331A1519Gxx / 331A1545Gx / 331A1543G1
detail: About 70 ANK/ANKT neutral kit numbers by box width/main config and ~30 ADS load base renewal numbers are in the BuyLog but were not individually catalogued in this batch.

topic: Original (pre-II) A-Series lighting panel branch connector hardware
detail: No OEM renewal-parts table found for AQ/AE branch bus connectors or deadfront filler pieces beyond TQLFP1/TEDFP1 and ASPTED3P/ASPTQD3P/ASPFB kits. Look for DEH-40007 and older GEH-xxxx A-Series instruction books.

topic: Legacy NLAB, NHB, NAB, CDP, AV-Line OEM documentation
detail: Only distributor/surplus evidence (NHB150PK; AV-Line switchboard listings). Seek GE GEH/GEF renewal parts bulletins for NLAB/NHB panelboards and AV-Line switchboards (e.g. archive.org, Bay Power, Relectric).

topic: A-Series II kits for other frames (FE, TFJ, TEYH 125A) and single-pole THQB
detail: DEH40150-40158 series covers SG, SF, TQD, SE/TED, THQB 6/12, TEY 6/12, FB; check DEH40159+ for further ASPP kits.

topic: Pow-R-Line C switchboard branch provision / connector kit catalog numbers
detail: Vol 12 p. V12-T15-5 says provisions/connectors are available for all PRLC ratings, but no catalog numbers are public. Obtain the PRLC distribution chassis renewal-parts/price list (Sumter) or a PRLC field-installation IL for adding group-mounted FD/JD/KD/LD/MDL/ND devices; confirm whether KPRL4/KPRL4X kits are the same parts.

topic: WF/WRP switchboard distribution-section connector and retrofit kits
detail: RP01400002E p.20 lists 'Retrofit kits for WF and WRP distribution sections' and 'Connector kits for WF and WRP distribution sections' from Sumter but gives no numbers. Check whether KCDP/KFDP kits are used, since WF/WRP feeders were CDP-type breakers and FDP switches.

topic: Price list PL01400002E (CDP/HCDP, FDP, PRL1-LX, PRL1, PRL2, PRL3) and PL01400001E
detail: Price lists would confirm full catalog-number sets (e.g. all KCDP retrofit permutations, KCDPnX fillers) and current availability.

topic: RP01400003E renewal parts for Cutler-Hammer MP40, MP-200, PB, PH, PH-L, EP, EE panelboards
detail: Referenced in Vol 12 Tab 4 for branch-device retrofit kits for Cutler-Hammer legacy panelboards (also plug-in power panels/switchboards EE/EP). Not retrieved.

topic: RP01414001E Panelboard Renewal Parts Supplement
detail: Referenced with RP01400001E in Vol 12 Tab 4 pp. V12-T4-15..19. Not found.

topic: PRL4 kit renumbering 2017 -> 2022 (KPRL4FD/ED/LD/MC/ND -> KPRL4X32/X22/LC/X34/X35)
detail: Comparison of RP01400001E Oct 2017 Table 37 and May 2022 Tables 46-47 suggests renumbering with Pow-R-Line Xpert (PD2-PD5 frames). Need explicit OEM supersession statement (April 2021 / Dec 2020 editions, Eaton product pages).

topic: TAD3 adapter kit contents and drawing
detail: Referenced in RP01400002E p.13 and Vol 12 Tab 3/4. Need kit contents, dimensions and whether it applies to switchboard LB provisions.

detail: Vol 2 Tab 4 may list PRLC field-installable kits; RP01301013E covers Systems Pow-R breaker renewal parts.

detail: Not transcribed in this batch to stay in scope: deadfront style numbers 5156C10H01-H09 (PRL1) / 5156C09H01-H09 (PRL2); boxes YS20xx, trims LT20xxS/F, LTT20xxS/F; Type 12/3R GWPB/LWPT/LWT; column panels 114D939Gxx, 6724D78Gxx; PRL3-LX 6726D69Gxx/6726D70Gxx.

detail: RP01400001E 2017 Table 36 / 2022 Table 45 list 1X-20X blank covers (style numbers) for 24 in and 36/44 in boxes; not transcribed here.

topic: Challenger panelboards (non-loadcenter) data
detail: No OEM renewal data found for Challenger-branded commercial panelboards; Vol 12 only gives BR loadcenter lineage (Challenger bought 1988).
